core.title: 20 Inch White Frosted Glass Shelf, Deltana 98C2015

text.description_html:
Deltana 98C2015, Classic White Glass Shampoo Shelf

The classic design of the steeped roses on the 98C Series Shelf makes is perfect for traditional styled homes. This 20" glass shelf has concealed screw mounting for a sleek look. The brackets are made of solid brass (available in satin nickel, polished chrome, or oil rubbed bronze finishes) and the glass self is made of white frosted glass. It is made with the attention to quality Deltana is known for and when mounted to the wall, this shampoo shelf will make a ultra fashionable--yet functional--accessory to any bathroom.

Shop more of the Deltana 98C Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the 98C Solid Brass Classic Glass Shampoo Shelf With Solid Brass Steeped Rose:

  • Length Center to Center: 15"
  • Glass Length: 20-7/8"
  • Glass Width: 4-7/8"
  • Overall Projection: 5-1/2"
  • Wall Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Material: solid brass wall mount (available in satin nickel, polished chrome, or oil rubbed bronze finishes) with a white frosted glass shelf.
  • Deltana 98C2015 20 Inch White Frosted Glass Shelf Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 glass shelf, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.
